Name: AutoTranslator
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center]AutoTranslator - A﻿I-Powered i18n Translation Mod[/center][/b][/size]
AutoTranslator is a completely redesigned SMAPI mod that specializes in automatic translation of mod i18n files using multiple AI providers. Now more stable, faster, and accurate than ever before.

[size=5][b]Key Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]i18n Specialization[/b][/size]
• [b]i18n-only translations[/b] - Removed unstable dynamic asset features
• [b]Automatic source language detection[/b] - Doesn't assume everything is in English
• [b]Support for `default/` structure[/b] - Translates complete `i18n/default/` folders
• [b]Token preservation[/b] - Keeps variables like `$query`, `{{player}}`, `{0}` untranslated

[size=4][b]Multiple AI Providers[/b][/size]
• [b]OpenAI[/b] - GPT-4o-mini (recommended)
• [b]DeepSeek[/b] - deepseek-chat model
• [b]Anthropic[/b] - Claude 3.5 Sonnet
• [b]Google[/b] - Gemini 1.5 Pro

[size=4][b]Smart Updates[/b][/size]
• [b]Smart Updates[/b] - Only translates modified files or new keys
• [b]Change detection[/b] - Automatically compares modification dates
• [b]Partial translation[/b] - Adds only missing keys
• [b]Case-sensitive comparisons[/b] - Prevents duplicate keys

[size=4][b]Robustness and Stability[/b][/size]
• [b]Robust error handling[/b] - Detailed logs and automatic recovery
• [b]Key validation[/b] - Prevents dictionary errors
• [b]Safe JSON loading[/b] - Consistent handling of corrupted files
• [b]Automatic retries[/b] - Fallback system for API errors

[size=5][b]Supported Formats[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Traditional Format[/b][/size]
[code]
YourMod/
├── i18n/
│ ├── default.json (or en.json)
│ └── es.json (generated automatically)
[/code]

[size=4][b]New `default/` Format[/b][/size]
[code]
YourMod/
├── i18n/
│ ├── default/
│ │ ├── items.json
│ │ ├── quests.json
│ │ └── dialogue.json
│ └── es/ (generated automatically)
│ ├── items.json
│ ├── quests.json
│ └── dialogue.json
[/code]

[size=5][b]Quick Setup[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Minimal Configuration (OpenAI)[/b][/size]
[code]
{
"AIProvider": "openai",
"OpenAIApiKey": "your-api-key-here",
"OpenAIModel": "gpt-4o-mini",
"UseGeneralLocale": true,
"EnableSmartUpdates": true,
"VerboseI18nLogging": false
}
[/code]

[size=4][b]DeepSeek Configuration (Budget-Friendly)[/b][/size]
[code]
{
"AIProvider": "deepseek",
"DeepSeekApiKey": "your-api-key-here",
"DeepSeekModel": "deepseek-chat",
"CallDelayMs": 500
}
[/code]

[size=4][b]Anthropic Configuration (High Quality)[/b][/size]
[code]
{
"AIProvider": "anthropic",
"AnthropicApiKey": "your-api-key-here",
"AnthropicModel": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620",
"CallDelayMs": 1000
}
[/code]

[size=4][b]Google Gemini Configuration (Versatile)[/b][/size]
[code]
{
"AIProvider": "google",
"GoogleApiKey": "your-api-key-here",
"GoogleModel": "gemini-1.5-pro",
"CallDelayMs": 600
}
[/code]

[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the mod in your `Mods/` folder
[*]Configure your AI provider and API key in `config.json`
[*]Start Stardew Valley and load a save file
[*]The mod will automatically detect and translate i18n files from all mods
[*]Translations are saved as physical files (no cache)
[/list]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

• [b]API Key[/b] from at least one supported provider

[size=5][b]Pro Tips[/b][/size]

• [b]OpenAI GPT-4o-mini[/b] offers the best quality-to-price ratio
• [b]DeepSeek[/b] is extremely cost-effective for large volumes
• [b]Enable `EnableSmartUpdates`[/b] for automatic mod updates
• [b]Use `VerboseI18nLogging: true`[/b] for debugging
• [b]Configure `CallDelayMs`[/b] according to your API limits

[size=5][b]Links[/b][/size]
